limitations: Net punt distance is not consistently available; gross distance is reported.

Kick and punt hang time, directional placement and coverage assignments are unavailable. Punt-return rates are attributed to the receiving team (defteam); punt gross and inside-20 metrics are attributed to the punting team (posteam).
EPA is attributed using the play-by-play posteam perspective; kickoff posteam is the receiving team.
Field-position averages are calculated only where drive_start_yard_line is populated.
Expected FG makes use league make rates by distance band in the current 2026 feed; they are a descriptive baseline, not a proprietary kicker model.
